__comment: Item entity definitions for all dropped / harvested resources.
Loaded on demand when an item is spawned — NOT held in memory at boot.
Fields:
display_name  — human-readable name shown in UI and tooltips
description   — one-sentence flavour text shown in the inspect panel
model         — path to the MagicaVoxel .glb micro-voxel model (res:// path)
stack_max     — legacy balancing hint; not used for physical storage capacity
crate_capacity — opted-in produce packaging capacity (24); absent means one unit
crate_models  — low / half / full models for counts 1-8 / 9-16 / 17-24
One crate occupies one ground cell or furniture slot. Loose drops
use the same crate; packaging is automatic and costs no resources.
carry_cost    — positive points per physical item against hauling.carry_capacity
A crate pays once regardless of fill; missing costs default to 1.
weight_class  — 'light' | 'heavy' — affects dwarf haul speed
light: full haul speed; heavy: ×0.7 haul speed while any heavy item
is in the load; independent of carry_cost
base_trade_value — base Trade Point (TP) value used by the trade session UI
actual price fluctuates ±20% based on caravan demand model
material_tags — flat string array; must include at least one 'stockpile_*' tag
used by stockpile zone filters and crafting ingredient queries
__comment_stone: Raw stone blocks — heavy, common, used for construction

base:resources:stone:granite.description: A rough block of dense igneous stone, useful for construction.

base:resources:stone:basalt.description: A dark volcanic stone, harder than granite.

base:resources:stone:limestone.description: A pale sedimentary stone, easy to cut and shape.

base:resources:stone:marble.description: A lustrous metamorphic stone prized for its elegance.

base:resources:stone:rough_stone.description: A rough-hewn chunk of mountain stone. Dwarves use it to wall up and backfill unwanted openings.

__comment_soil: Soft earth — farmable cave soil is the most valuable

base:resources:soil:cave_soil.description: Rich subterranean earth, ideal for underground farming.

base:resources:soil:light_soil.description: Sandy pale earth, too dry for farming but useful as fill.

base:resources:soil:dark_soil.description: Dense clay-rich earth with a damp, earthy smell.

__comment_ore: Metal ore chunks — heavy, moderate trade value

base:resources:ore:copper.description: A green-tinged ore chunk, the first metal dwarves learn to smelt.

base:resources:ore:tin.description: A soft grey ore found near the surface. Easy to smelt, useful for early tools.

base:resources:ore:iron.description: A heavy reddish ore, the backbone of dwarven industry.

base:resources:ore:silver.description: A pale lustrous ore found in mid-depth veins. Valuable for jewellery and trade.

base:resources:ore:coal.description: A brittle black rock that burns long and hot.

base:resources:ore:gold.description: A gleaming heavy ore. Even raw it catches every torch.

__comment_gem: Raw gem crystals — light, very high trade value

base:resources:gem:jade_raw.description: A dense green stone, prized for carving. Cooler to the touch than you'd expect.

base:resources:gem:amethyst_raw.description: A translucent purple crystal that catches torchlight beautifully.

base:resources:gem:ruby_raw.description: An uncut crimson crystal pulled from deep volcanic stone.

base:resources:gem:sapphire_raw.description: A deep blue crystal that seems to hold starlight within.

base:resources:gem:emerald_raw.description: A vivid green crystal found only in the deepest rock seams.

base:resources:gem:diamond_raw.description: An uncut diamond pulled from the uttermost dark. Merchants go silent when they see one.

base:resources:misc:fossil_fragment.description: A stone impression of an ancient creature. Scholars pay handsomely.

base:resources:wood:pine_log.description: A straight-grained softwood log, light and easy to work. The backbone of early construction.

base:resources:wood:oak_log.description: A dense hardwood log with a tight grain. Prized for furniture and barrel staves.

base:resources:wood:oak_stave.description: A split plank of seasoned oak shaped for cooperage. Essential for crafting aging casks.

base:resources:wood:apple_wood.description: A fine-grained pinkish wood. Burns slowly with a sweet scent, useful for smoking and light carpentry.

base:resources:wood:juniper_log.description: A fragrant hardwood log with dense, knotted grain.

__comment_flora: Harvested plant matter — crops, berries, seeds

base:resources:flora:elderberry.description: Dark purple clusters with a tart depth. The classic base for mountain wine.

base:resources:flora:blueberry.description: Sweet high-altitude berries with a clean finish. Prized for mead and summer ales.

base:resources:flora:wild_strawberry.description: Tiny and intensely sweet. Merchants go quiet when they see a basket of these.

base:resources:flora:juniper_berry.description: Tart blue-black berries with a resinous bite. Prized for gin-style brewing.

base:resources:flora:plump_helmet.description: A bulbous purple mushroom that grows fast in moist cave soil.

base:resources:flora:pig_tail.description: A curling fibrous plant that can be spun into rough cloth.

base:resources:flora:apple.description: A crisp mountain apple. Sweet enough to eat raw, better pressed into cider.

__comment_seed: Seeds — planted by dwarves to start new crop growth

base:resources:seed:pine_cone.description: A seed-bearing cone from a mature pine. Plant it and wait a few seasons.

base:resources:seed:oak_acorn.description: A small but promising acorn. Oaks are slow to grow and worth every year of the wait.

base:resources:seed:apple_seed.description: A seed pressed from a mountain apple. Give it good soil and a few seasons.

base:resources:seed:elderberry_cutting.description: A fresh stem cutting from an elderberry bush. Root it in surface soil to grow a new bush.

base:resources:seed:blueberry_cutting.description: A small blueberry stem. Plant it on rocky high-ground soil for best results.

base:resources:seed:strawberry_cutting.description: A runner cutting from a wild strawberry plant. Grows quickly in good surface soil.

base:resources:seed:pig_tail_seed.description: A small hard seed from a pig tail plant. Sow in surface dirt before summer for a full season's fiber harvest.

base:resources:seed:juniper_seed.description: A hard dark seed that takes root slowly but grows into a towering tree.

__comment_drink: Finished brewed drinks — colony morale and trade goods

base:resources:drink:ale.description: A dark, malty ale brewed from cave wheat or plump helmets.

base:resources:drink:mead.description: A golden honey-wine brewed from sweet pods. Light, complex, and expensive.

__comment_misc2: Processed goods — outputs from non-brewing workshops

base:resources:misc:cloth.description: A coarse woven fabric spun from pig tail fibers.

base:resources:misc:water_bucket.description: A wooden bucket filled from a well or underground stream.

__comment_new_flora: New brewing crops — hops and grapes

base:resources:flora:hops.description: Papery green cones with a sharp, resinous bite. The bitter backbone of any proper ale.

base:resources:flora:grape.description: Heavy purple clusters from the mountain vine terraces. Sweet, complex, and worth the wait.

__comment_honey: Honey — produced by beehives, used in mead and cider

base:resources:misc:honey.description: Thick golden honey from mountain beehives. Adds body and sweetness to brewed drinks.

__comment_new_seeds: New plant propagation items — hops and grape cuttings

base:resources:seed:hops_cutting.description: A rooted stem cutting from a mature hops bine. Plant it on surface soil before summer.

base:resources:seed:grape_cutting.description: A short cane cutting from a fruiting grape vine. Takes a season to establish but lasts for years.

__comment_new_drinks: New brewed drinks — stout, cider, wine, gin, and their aged variants

base:resources:drink:stout.description: A thick, near-black ale with a roasted bitterness. Dwarves call it 'proper drinking'.

base:resources:drink:cider.description: A crisp, lightly honeyed apple cider. Brisk and refreshing after a long shift in the mines.

base:resources:drink:wine.description: A deep, tannic wine pressed from mountain grapes. Not a dwarf's first choice, but the merchants love it.

base:resources:drink:gin.description: A sharp, resinous spirit distilled from juniper berries. An acquired taste — and a profitable one.

__comment_aged_drinks: Aged premium variants — produced in the aging cellar, high trade value

base:resources:drink:aged_stout.description: A stout that has sat in oak for a month of cold stone silence. Smooth, complex, and deeply satisfying.

base:resources:drink:vintage_wine.description: An oak-aged mountain wine that has mellowed into something extraordinary. Caravans will pay dearly.

base:resources:drink:reserve_gin.description: Juniper gin rested in oak until the harsh edge softens to something almost elegant.

__comment_special: Special items — unique or limited-use objects that anchor major game flows

base:items:special:settlement_flag.description: A folded banner and stout marker pole used to choose where the first settlement will take root.
